items.reason: Describes the same unguarded integration access when destinationCalendar is null or empty, crashing the Google Meet fallback.

Explicitly describes dropping credentialId from video references, preventing meeting deletion on cancellation. This broader comment also includes the updateLocation routing-data loss described by #12.
Describes providers selecting the first host's destination for every credential, including the Office365 and Lark problem in #05. Passing a destination-specific event fixes that same targeting error.
Initializing the null destinationCalendar before appending fixes the same loss of other collective hosts' destination calendars.
Describes the same credentialId-only selection ignoring legacy destinations and inserting into primary instead of the configured calendar.
Describes the same first-destination selection in Lark and Office365, causing secondary hosts' credentials to target the first host's calendar.
Describes inconsistent calendarId fallback between Google's insert and subsequent description patch. Fixing the patch to use primary does not fix #14's incorrect destination selection.
Describes the recurring deletion sweep executing once per calendar reference, producing duplicate provider delete calls.
Describes the same update/delete fallback comparing destination externalId against an already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the configured destination.
